text:
I signed up for a data science bootcamp last year, but by month three, I hit a wall. The math felt impossible, and the guilt of an unfinished course turned into paralysis. I left the tab open for weeks, convinced I simply wasn't cut out for it.

Then, I changed my strategy: I committed to just fifteen minutes a day. That tiny shift broke the cycle of avoidance. I finally earned my certificate last week. It wasn't about speed; it was about showing up when it felt hardest.
